review_candidates.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: About Modern Campus Modern Campus empowers institutions to move with confidence across the modern learner journey. Our platform spans web content management, curriculum and catalog management, student engagement and lifelong learning — giving more than 1,700 colleges and universities the infrastructure they need to support the entire learner-to-earner lifecycle and deliver personalized, scalable experiences. We partner with the education community to create new pathways for learning and opportunity, reimagining how institutions serve the modern learner and shape the future of education. Our purpose — our north star — is to empower institutions to confidently serve and support the modern learner. This mission and purpose come to life through how we show up every day: We exist to create empowerment through education. We lead with honesty and empathy. We shape the future through innovation. We become trusted partners. We make the complex feel possible. Purpose Modern Campus is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to build, operate, and improve the cloud infrastructure supporting our higher education products. Our environment is primarily AWS, with additional workloads in Microsoft Azure. You will bring strong production Kubernetes experience, infrastructure automation skills, and sound judgment when working with customer-facing systems. You will own engineering work from design through production operation, partnering with Development and Information Security to modernize applications, improve reliability, and reduce manual work. You will also contribute to technical direction, mentor engineers, and participate in the on-call rotation. For candidates with demonstrated technical leadership across teams, we are open to discussing a broader scope and level. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate AWS infrastructure, including production workloads on Amazon EKS and ECS/Fargate. Own infrastructure projects through design, testing, deployment, rollback planning, documentation, and operational handoff. Develop infrastructure as code, deployment automation, and reusable platform capabilities using tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Helm, and Argo CD. Build and maintain deployment pipelines and automation, partnering with Development on application modernization, scaling, validation, production readiness, and rollback procedures. Troubleshoot infrastructure and application issues across operating systems, networking, containers, application runtimes, and database dependencies. Improve monitoring, performance, and cost efficiency; implement security controls in partnership with Information Security; maintain platform upgrades and patching, and test backup restoration and disaster recovery procedures. Contribute to technical standards and design reviews, mentor engineers, and work with management to prioritize risks and improvements. Participate in the on-call rotation, lead incident diagnosis, and carry out planned maintenance. Communicate clearly during incidents and use follow-up work, automation, and runbooks to reduce recurring issues. Requirements Substantial infrastructure and DevOps experience, typically eight or more years in infrastructure and five or more years in automation-focused roles, or equivalent demonstrated expertise. Strong hands-on production Kubernetes experience, including upgrades, networking, access controls, scaling, and troubleshooting. Amazon EKS experience is strongly preferred. Strong AWS experience across networking, IAM, compute, storage, load balancing, and managed databases. Practical experience with Terraform, containers, Helm, and Git-based deployment workflows, including building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, or comparable tools. Strong Linux administration and troubleshooting skills, including DNS, HTTP/TLS, and system performance. Strong practical networking and troubleshooting skills, including routing, firewalls, and secure connectivity such as site-to-site VPNs or SSH tunnels. Ability to write maintainable automation in Python, Go, PowerShell, or another suitable language, alongside shell scripting. Experience diagnosing application and database issues using metrics, logs, traces, and monitoring tools. Demonstrated ability to independently deliver complex work, make safe production changes, and communicate technical decisions across teams. A degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Additional Experience We Value Experience in one or more of the following areas is helpful but not required. Technical leadership across teams, including architecture, standards, mentoring, and adoption of shared capabilities. Modernizing established applications and building self-service tooling. Experience with Argo CD or Ansible. Experience supporting technologies such as Windows, Java/JVM, web servers, relational databases, Kafka/MSK, or OpenSearch. Experience with Microsoft Azure or assessing and integrating unfamiliar infrastructure through acquisitions or migrations. Experience with Keycloak or similar identity platforms, including single sign-on integrations using SAML or OpenID Connect. AI-assisted engineering and operational automation with appropriate testing, review, and access controls. What We Believe... At Modern Campus, we believe that a diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace furthers relevance, resilience, and longevity. We encourage people from all backgrounds, ages, abilities, and experiences to apply for our positions. Modern Campus is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to bring on hires regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status (for US candidates). If you require accommodations during any part of the interview process due to a disability, please let our recruiter know. Our salary ranges reflect the minimum and maximum target for new hires for the position within the US and Canada. Within the range, individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Junior Support Engineer based in Netherlands. We are seeking a motivated Junior Support Engineer to help maintain the reliability and performance of a global digital testing platform. In this role, you will support cloud-based and on-premises infrastructure, troubleshoot hardware, software, and network issues, and respond to incidents affecting critical services. You will work closely with technical teams and data center personnel across international locations to diagnose problems and restore service quickly. From monitoring alerts to customer-reported incidents, you will take ownership of support tickets and follow them through to resolution. This opportunity is ideal for an early-career IT professional eager to develop practical troubleshooting skills in a collaborative, fast-paced technical environment. You will also contribute to improving operational processes, documentation, and service reliability while learning from experienced engineering teams. Accountabilities As a Junior Support Engineer, you will help ensure the stability and availability of devices, servers, networks, and supporting infrastructure. You will manage incidents from initial identification through resolution, coordinate with relevant teams, and contribute to a consistent and responsive support process. Triage and respond to incident and outage tickets generated by automated monitoring systems or customer reports. Track support tickets through resolution, ensuring issues are handled within established service-level agreement (SLA) response times. Collaborate with internal technical teams and escalate incidents appropriately when additional expertise is required. Coordinate with global sites, data center technicians, and on-site support personnel to troubleshoot and recover unresponsive hardware and services. Work with cloud and on-premises infrastructure teams to investigate technical disruptions and restore service. Troubleshoot mobile device hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues. Participate in an on-call rotation to provide continuous incident response and support coverage. Follow established incident management procedures to resolve issues efficiently, reliably, and consistently. Document troubleshooting workflows, recurring problems, and operational playbooks to improve team effectiveness. Assist with maintenance, upgrades, and updates to critical software and network infrastructure. Support or recommend device deployments, upgrades, and ongoing maintenance activities. Communicate clearly with customers, technical colleagues, and other stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle. Collaborate with remote team members to maintain productive working relationships and share technical knowledge. Provide feedback on recurring incidents, operational challenges, and process improvements to strengthen support operations. Requirements The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic early-career technical professional with foundational IT knowledge, a structured approach to troubleshooting, and a strong commitment to customer support. You should be eager to learn new tools, take ownership of technical issues, and collaborate effectively with distributed teams. Between 0 and 2 years of experience in technical support or a comparable role. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent qualifications. Basic knowledge of incident response involving network and software infrastructure. Understanding of networking fundamentals, including LAN, WAN, VLANs, firewalls, switches, and wireless access points. Familiarity with operating systems such as Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS. Knowledge of command-line tools and Unix-like environments, including SSH, SCP, Bash, cURL, Vim, Python terminal tools, ping, and tcpdump. Familiarity with collaboration and issue-tracking tools such as Google Workspace, Jira, Slack, and Zoom. Understanding of service desks, SLAs, escalation procedures, on-call rotations, and common workflow practices such as sprints and Kanban. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a systematic approach to identifying root causes and resolving issues. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. A proactive, technology-oriented mindset and willingness to learn new tools, systems, and processes. A customer-focused attitude and commitment to resolving support requests in a timely and effective manner. Strong prioritisation and time-management skills, with the ability to assess requests according to urgency and business impact. Willingness to cross-train with other IT team members and contribute to a broader shared knowledge base. A strong sense of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail. Benefits Opportunity to gain hands-on experience supporting global cloud and on-premises infrastructure. Practical exposure to incident management, networking, mobile devices, and systems troubleshooting. Collaboration with experienced technical and engineering teams across international locations. Opportunities to develop technical skills through cross-training and exposure to new technologies. The opportunity to contribute ideas that improve operational processes, documentation, and service reliability. review_candidates.title: Staff System Engineer- Mechatronic Flash Programming
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Team: The Programming, EIO/HWIO (Ethernet Input/Output Hardware Input/Output) Systems Engineering Team represents two of the eight Mech Infra Systems teams: the Mech Infra Programming System and the Controller Hardware System (EIO/HWIO); the other six are Diagnostics, Ethernet Communications, Non-Ethernet Communications, Power Management, Safety, and Cybersecurity. The Programming System owns the end-to-end strategy, requirements, flows, test automation, and recovery behavior that enable SDV ECUs to be safely, securely, and repeatably programmed and updated across development, manufacturing, service, and field environments. The EIO/HWIO System defines and validates controller input/output capabilities—including sensing, actuation, diagnostics, I/O mapping, performance, and voltage-reference monitoring—to ensure controllers and Ethernet I/O devices operate reliably and are diagnosable. Together, these two systems represent complementary areas of Mech Infra SW: Programming manages how software is delivered and updated, while EIO/HWIO enables the controller-level interfaces through which the system interacts with physical devices. Programming also supports any previous electrical architectures such as VIP. The Role: General Motors is currently seeking a Staff System Engineer specializing in Mechatronic Flash Programming. This role will define, implement, and continuously improve flash-programming requirements, architectures, tools, and validation strategies for advanced mechatronic systems across GM vehicle programs. The engineer will serve as a technical lead across development, manufacturing, over-the-air (OTA), and service programming environments. The role connects system requirements, embedded software, diagnostics, vehicle networks, programming tools, test automation, cybersecurity, and manufacturing execution to deliver reliable and efficient vehicle software updates. What You'll Do (Responsibilities): Define and deliver flash-programming requirements and solutions for advanced mechatronic systems across GM vehicle programs. Lead programming strategies for development, manufacturing, OTA, and service environments. Partner with software, hardware, diagnostics, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and vehicle-integration teams to deliver reliable solutions. Develop and improve programming tools, diagnostics, scripts, and automated tests. Analyze programming issues, identify root causes, and drive effective corrective actions. Maintain requirements, test coverage, traceability, and technical documentation. Establish reusable standards and practices that improve programming quality, efficiency, and scalability. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and roadmap direction for programming capabilities in future architectures Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on complex programming tasks. Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for flash programming quality and efficiency. Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications): Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. 10+ years of experience in Software Development, with a strong focus on embedded systems or automotive applications. Strong experience with automotive flash programming, embedded systems, vehicle diagnostics, and software requirements. Experience developing or reviewing software, scripts, engineering tools, or test automation. Experience across the software or systems development lifecycle and with agile methods. Experience using Wireshark or similar tools to analyze PCAP and diagnostic traffic. People Skills: Exceptional Cross-Functional Leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across diverse teams. A strong commitment to Continuous Learning and staying abreast of industry trends and emerging technologies. Demonstrated ability in Group Problem Solving and analytical thinking to resolve complex technical issues. Proven Strategic Leadership capabilities in defining and executing technical roadmaps. What Will Give You A Competitive Edge (Preferred Qualifications): Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience with automotive diagnostic protocols (e.g., UDS) and vehicle communication networks (e.g., CAN, Ethernet) is highly desirable. Experience programming clients and interfaces. Experience with programming archives, binary and calibration content, utility files, interpreter specifications, archive parsers, or content-selection tools. Experience with manufacturing end-of-line programming, OTA programming, or dealership programming. Experience with C++, Python, C#, or other languages used for tool development and automation. Demonstrated ability to use AI tools to enhance productivity, solve complex problems, and validate outputs. Experience with Software defined vehicle architectures, centralized computing, vehicle gateways, aggregators, system managers, or virtual ECUs. Company Vehicle : Upon successful completion of a motor vehicle report review, you will be eligible to participate in a company vehicle evaluation program, through which you will be assigned a General Motors vehicle to drive and evaluate. Note: program participants are required to purchase/lease a qualifying GM vehicle every four years unless one of a limited number of exceptions applies. GM does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need GM immigration sponsorship now or in the future. This includes direct company sponsorship, entry of GM as the immigration employer of record on a government form, and any work authorization requiring a written submission or other immigration support from the company (e.g., H1-B, OPT, STEM OPT, CPT, TN, J-1, etc). This role is categorized as hybrid. This means the selected candidate is expected to report to a specific location at least 3 times a week {or other frequency dictated by their manager}. Relocation benefits are available for candidates who qualify under company policy. review_candidates.title: Senior Embedded Systems Engineer
review_candidates.description: Jouw toekomst als vertrekpunt Je werkt graag aan embedded systemen, maar wilt meer doen dan alleen software ontwikkelen. Je overziet het grotere geheel, schakelt makkelijk tussen verschillende disciplines en vindt het interessant om technische wijzigingen van analyse tot implementatie te begeleiden. Als Senior Embedded Systems Engineer werk je op het snijvlak van embedded software, electronics en systems engineering. Je bent inhoudelijk betrokken bij technische vraagstukken, maar hebt tegelijkertijd een belangrijke rol in de afstemming tussen R&D, Quality, Supply Chain en andere stakeholders. Je krijgt veel verantwoordelijkheid binnen het bestaande productportfolio en hebt de mogelijkheid om je verder te ontwikkelen richting een coördinerende of Lead Engineer-rol. Highlights • Salaris tot €5.800 bruto per maand • 13e maand • Technisch inhoudelijke rol met veel coördinatie en stakeholdermanagement Wat ga je doen Als Senior Embedded Systems Engineer ben je verantwoordelijk voor het beoordelen, begeleiden en implementeren van technische wijzigingen binnen bestaande producten. Je verzamelt input vanuit verschillende disciplines zoals R&D, Quality en Supply Chain en vertaalt deze naar een duidelijke technische scope. Daarbij beoordeel je wijzigingsvoorstellen en requirements en zorg je ervoor dat verbeteringen technisch goed worden uitgewerkt en geïmplementeerd. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met embedded software, electronics en control-systemen en beheert technische specificaties en releases binnen tools zoals GitHub. Daarnaast begeleid je test- en validatietrajecten, stem je af met interne en externe stakeholders en bewaak je relevante normen, kwaliteitsrichtlijnen en technische requirements. Binnen het team krijg je veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen. Op termijn bestaat de mogelijkheid om verder door te groeien richting een meer coördinerende rol waarin je andere engineers begeleidt en technisch richting geeft. Dit breng je mee • Je beschikt minimaal een HBO diploma in een technische richting zoals Embedded Systems, Electronics of Mechatronica • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Embedded Systems, Electronics of Mechatronics • Je bent in staat om technische vraagstukken vanuit meerdere disciplines te overzien • Je schakelt makkelijk met engineers, leveranciers en andere stakeholders • Je bent communicatief sterk en neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid • Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal • Nederlands is een pré • Ervaring met Python, MATLAB/Simulink en/of SimScape is een pré Wat je ervoor terugkrijgt • Salaris tussen €4.400 – €5.800 bruto per maand afhankelijk van ervaring • 13e maand • 27 vakantiedagen + 7 ADV dagen • Ruimte om 2 dagen in de week thuis te werken Over de opdrachtgever De opdrachtgever is een internationale technische organisatie die complexe, technisch hoogwaardige producten ontwikkelt en produceert voor verschillende markten.
